post.description: Primary Purpose: Acknowledge a nurse call by marking the Call record's acknowledged_at timestamp and computing response_time_seconds; returns the serialized Call. post.description: Primary purpose: mark a Call record as attended by setting its attended_at timestamp and computing attend_delay_seconds, then return the serialized Call.
